ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white/grey) pixels, estimated at approximately 85:15 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity continuous black surface; high-intensity localized white pixel clusters (scars) distributed medially; high-intensity grey-white mottling at distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations characterized by jagged peaks and valleys across the continuous trailing edge; significant jaggedness and erosion-like markers at distal extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex macro-curve fitted to both lobes, extending from the median notch to the distal tips, with significant micro-scale deviations due to edge serration.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed; one prominent diagonal high-intensity line on the left lobe and several vertical scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization appearing as irregular, multi-pixel high-contrast protrusions at both the far-left and far-right distal tips; significant rake mark scarring on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, bulbous clusters of biological growth (likely barnacles) creating a highly irregular 3D-effect topography at the extreme lateral edges of the flukes.
